historical_record.description: Designed by Backen Arrigoni & Ross — one of the few Brutalist large apartment buildings in San Francisco.

historic_survey.survey: Modern & Postmodern Architectural Styles Historic Context Statement (2024)
historic_survey.note: An apartment building by Backen Arrigoni & Ross with exposed raw concrete exteriors, visible formwork tie holes, articulated floorplates and expressive sculptural massing - a rare and unique Brutalist multi-family building in San Francisco, which the statement finds eligible as a historic resource.
